freeze.sub-freeze-desc: If you will not be able to follow Prime and enjoy all the benefits of a subscription for a long time, you can use the freeze function.
freeze.how-works-desc: As soon as you freeze your subscription, you will immediately lose access to all Prime services, but there will be subscription days on your account that you have not used yet. You can unfreeze your subscription and return all accesses at any time in the same section.
freeze.footer: Please note that you can only freeze your subscription once a year!

ref-info.heading: How the referral system works?
ref-info.text-1: Invite new users to Prime and receive up to 20% of their every payment on a regular basis. Your referrals get a discount $5 for the first purchase.
ref-info.text-2: The more users are invited, the higher the percentage of each referral payment!
ref-info.after-10: After reaching level 10, you can receive up to 30% of each referral purchase. To do this, contact your Mentor.
